description: The page and Node use the same native ES2022 build of unchanged markdown-it 15.0.2 release source (MARKDOWNIT.json). tools/entities-vendor.mjs re-encodes its 2,125 HTML entity names as a compact list with the strict decoder its callers require, then minifies with the pinned options. The normal Rapier core rule in agent/markdown-spec.mjs owns auto-link token expansion; the vendor has no parser rule changes. Each vendor pins upstream and derived bytes; a changed source or derivation requires grammar and entity equivalence before repinning.
